item.title: IAF wing commander ‘honey-trapped’ by Pak operatives; charged for alleged info leak
item.description: A Wing Commander in the Indian Air Force is currently under serious accusations of leaking critical defense information. It is reported that he fell victim to a honey trap orchestrated by operatives from Pakistani intelligence using social media. Allegations suggest he secretly installed software designed to steal data on a colleague's device. Prior to his arrest by the Delhi Police, he was under close scrutiny by the IAF.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Vance calls PM after US Senate passes 100% tariff bill, discusses boosting ties
item.description: On Saturday, VP JD Vance engaged in a conversation with PM Narendra Modi, reiterating both nations' dedication to strengthen partnerships in vital sectors such as trade, defense, and upcoming technologies. They shared insights on international matters of shared concern, coinciding with the US Senate's approval of a bill focused on Russian oil transactions.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Captain of turbulence-hit Phuket-Delhi flight may have failed dope test
item.description: During a turbulent flight from Phuket to Delhi, the captain of an Air India aircraft reportedly tested positive for psychoactive substances. The turbulence caused a significant scare, resulting in hospitalization for thirteen passengers and four crew members. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation is conducting a detailed investigation, and the flight crew has been suspended from flying duties as per standard procedures.
item.dc:creator: SAURABH SINHA

item.title: Australia pacer takes 8/25 as Bangladesh bowled out for 54, lose match by innings
item.description: Campbell Thompson was the main contributor to Bangladesh’s collapse, taking eight wickets for 25 runs in the second innings at Marrara Oval. The 22-year-old left-arm fast bowler had taken two wickets late on Friday before returning on Saturday morning to claim six more as Bangladesh lost eight wickets for 35 runs.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: Government appoints 30 judges to high courts of Calcutta, MP, Karnataka, Madras
item.description: The law ministry notified thirty new judges for four high courts on Saturday. Madras High Court received fifteen appointments, while Calcutta got eight and Karnataka six. Judicial officers and advocates were elevated to the benches, with most appointed as additional judges. Over sixty lakh cases are pending across India's twenty-five high courts. The law minister cited collegium delays for the significant number of vacancies.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Elon Musk says Starship Flight 13 recovery ‘not looking good’ after splashdown
item.description: SpaceX's Starship recovery is struggling against the tumultuous waters of the Indian Ocean, with Elon Musk admitting the situation appears grim. Despite these difficulties, engineers managed to capture invaluable images of essential spacecraft components. This visual data is expected to contribute significantly to enhancements in Starship design and its reusability. Notably, the mission marked SpaceX's most successful Starship test flight to date.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Proposed MDR for UPI transactions will be nominal, says government
item.description: The government has pledged that the upcoming UPI merchant discount rate will be minimal. This fee will be applicable only to certain merchants and transactions that surpass a designated threshold. Importantly, person-to-person UPI payments will remain free for all users. This initiative is designed to enhance the sustainability of India’s digital payment ecosystem and facilitate service expansion into rural and semi-urban regions.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: 6 years after NDA exit, Punjab's SAD backs delimitation push
item.description: Akali Dal president Sukhbir Singh Badal now supports the women's reservation law rollout. This move signals the government's potential revival of the Constitution amendment bill. The government is also seeking support from DMK and NCP(SP) for the measure. The bill aims to increase Lok Sabha's strength by fifty percent. Its timing remains uncertain as lawmakers consider summoning Parliament.
item.dc:creator: KUMAR RAKESH

item.title: Government spending on education below Unesco's 15% standard
item.description: India's education funding aligns with GDP standards but falls short of public spending goals. Completion rates for secondary schools lag behind national and UNESCO guidelines. This funding pattern emerges as countries shift focus from education financial targets. India's extensive education initiatives benefit millions of students, yet the sector continues to grapple with persistent challenges despite increased program deployment.
item.dc:creator: MANASH PRATIM GOHAIN

item.title: Michael Dell’s son’s startup offers $695 alternative to costly home generators
item.description: Zach Dell's Base Power is installing home battery systems across America. These systems offer backup power and reduce electricity bills for customers. The company aims to replace expensive gas generators with its innovative technology. Base Power is rapidly expanding its operations and customer base nationwide. This startup is valued at thirteen billion dollars after significant funding.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: EPFO, officers' body contest claims about new IT system
item.description: The rollout of EPFO's new IT system has resulted in a substantial backlog of claim issues. Field officials are grappling with an increasing number of pending auto claims, which have lingered for over twenty days and are causing significant discomfort to members. EPFO admits that this surge in pendency is a short-term effect of the system transition, although it was executed with minimal disruption to services.
item.dc:creator: SHIVA RAJORA

item.title: Houston man’s solo trash cleanups grow into 100-volunteer movement
item.description: A Houston resident's initiative to clean up neglected areas has blossomed into a vibrant volunteer movement. With one hundred dedicated individuals now on board, their mission is to remove illegally dumped waste. Collaborating with local organizations and harnessing the power of social media, city officials and law enforcement are boosting efforts to tackle this pressing issue, ultimately enhancing the community's aesthetics and the well-being of its residents.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Billionaire couple offers $150M to make San Francisco better to live in
item.description: Billionaires Michael Moritz and Harriet Heyman have launched an ambitious $150 million initiative aimed at enhancing San Francisco. Through their foundation, Crankstart, they invite innovative solutions to tackle urgent housing and economic challenges. Organizations can compete for funding, with the evaluation process culminating in a decision set for autumn 2027. This competition highlights the city's increasing dependency on private philanthropy in addressing critical public needs.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: Mark Zuckerberg gave an update on ‘Meta's 4 am layoff email’ to employees
item.description: During an earnings call, Meta's CEO highlighted the difficult decision to lay off 8,000 employees, which is integral to a transformative AI-focused restructuring plan. While costs related to compensation and infrastructure continue to escalate, the company boasts strong revenue performance. Meta's proactive investments in AI infrastructure are poised to usher in new employment opportunities in an evolving digital ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: TOI TECH DESK

item.title: Captain moves crew to citadel, thwarts pirate assault on India-bound vessel
item.description: In a daring move, the Indian Navy successfully thwarted a pirate assault on the Golden Arsenal in the perilous Gulf of Aden. The ship’s crew effectively sought refuge within an impregnable citadel that the invaders could not penetrate. Currently, four vessels remain under the control of Somali pirates, with Indian nationals on three of them.
item.dc:creator: DIPAK K DASH

item.title: Raids in four Kashmir districts in anti-national narrative case
item.description: On Saturday, Counter Intelligence Kashmir executed raids at five locations spread across the districts of Baramulla, Bandipora, Anantnag, and Shopian. During these operations, several electronic and digital storage devices were confiscated as part of an investigation into an anti-national narrative. As of now, no arrests have been reported in relation to this ongoing case.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Two memorials of 1962 war heroes figure in 27 places formally named in Arunachal
item.description: The Union government has formally named twenty-seven locations in Arunachal Pradesh. These places include memorials honoring Indian Army war heroes from past conflicts. Havildar Shere Thapa and Rifleman Jaswant Singh Rawat are among those recognized for bravery. Several strategically important mountain passes and a logistics hub were also officially identified. This action pays homage to soldiers who sacrificed their lives defending India's borders.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: LeBron James’ wife Savannah reveals why Hermès saleswoman turned her away
item.description: Savannah James opened up about an alleged Hermès shopping dispute in Italy, claiming a saleswoman was fired after she and April McDaniel were reportedly turned away despite having an appointment. The friends later described how the store addressed the situation. Savannah also discussed marriage, motherhood and life alongside LeBron James, stressing the importance of staying grounded, authentic and invested in a relationship despite the pressure of public life.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Hulk Hogan’s son Nick shares family update a year after WWE legend’s death
item.description: Hulk Hogan's son Nick discusses family coping one year after his father's passing. The family remains supportive and close, honoring the wrestling icon's memory. Nick is now leading several businesses connected to his father's famous name. They celebrated Hulk Hogan Day and continue their strong relationship with WWE. The family is focused on making Hulk Hogan proud through their ongoing projects.
item.dc:creator: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK

item.title: Rijiju, Rahul trade barbs over women's quota bill rollout
item.description: Union minister Kiren Rijiju called on LoP Rahul Gandhi to back the women's reservation bill during their exchange. In response, Rahul Gandhi noted that the 2023 bill had already received unanimous approval. He raised concerns about the holdup in implementing the legislation and its connection to the delimitation process. Gandhi insisted on prompt action to enforce the 2023 law, underscoring the heated political discourse on women's empowerment.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: Restore J&K statehood, says human rights forum
item.description: An advocacy group for human rights calls for the restoration of statehood and the repeal of the 2019 Reorganisation Act. They argue that statehood should not be contingent upon the regional security situation. The forum additionally demands statehood for Ladakh and its inclusion in the Sixth Schedule. Their report highlights police inadequacies despite court mandates on detentions and brings attention to the injustices faced by Kashmiris after acts of terrorism.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: Science min dedicates to nation first-of-its-kind ‘eco-educational hub’ in Lucknow
item.description: Union science minister Jitendra Singh launched the CSIR-NBRI eco-educational hub in Lucknow, a dynamic facility focusing on environmental education and the conservation of biodiversity. The hub includes an enlightening heritage trail that highlights India's botanical heritage and a specialised Bamboosteum that showcases various uses of bamboo. Moreover, attendees witnessed the introduction of a new herbal formulation designed to support male reproductive health.
item.dc:creator: SURENDRA SINGH

item.title: Scientists uncover the aluminium shield helping a tiny crustacean survive
item.description: In a groundbreaking discovery, scientists have identified a deep-sea crustacean, the amphipod Hirondellea gigas, which uses aluminum to survive in the Mariana Trench, one of Earth's most extreme environments. Its unique aluminum-coated exoskeleton helps resist calcium dissolution under immense pressure, allowing it to thrive where life was previously deemed impossible. This remarkable adaptation showcases innovative survival mechanisms in the deep ocean.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.title: IN-SPACe moves to privatise operations of Rs 986 cr spaceport
item.description: IN-SPACe is actively on the lookout for private partners to operate Isro's new small satellite launch complex located in Tamil Nadu. This innovative facility is expected to streamline small rocket launches and improve operational efficiency. The chosen operator will oversee all functional aspects, while Isro commits to providing technical training and guidelines during a specified duration. The initiative aims to elevate India's capabilities in small satellite launches.
item.dc:creator: CHETHAN KUMAR

item.title: FIR against 17 for assaulting 4 transporting bovines in J&K
item.description: Seventeen alleged cow vigilantes are facing legal action in Ramban after assaulting four men who were transporting bovines acquired from a police auction. The brutal incident, which occurred on August 4, resulted in one man suffering life-threatening injuries. This alarming event follows a fatal encounter in April, highlighting ongoing violence linked to cow protection. Investigations into wrongful restraint and assault are currently underway.
item.dc:creator: SANJAY KHAJURIA

item.title: Kashmir route outpaces Manali as Ladakh tourism surges
item.description: In the period from January to July, Ladakh has welcomed a remarkable 330,332 tourists. Air travel continues to be the favored mode of access to this stunning union territory. Among road travelers, the route through Kashmir is increasingly popular over the Manali path. Enhanced infrastructure and well-planned events have fueled this tourism surge, with burgeoning homestays offering fresh job opportunities for the local community.
item.dc:creator: NASEER GANAI

item.title: ‘Toxic’ trailer X review: Yash’s bold scene shocks fans, netizens predict Rs 3,000 cr
item.description: The highly anticipated trailer for Yash's film 'Toxic' has just dropped, igniting fervor among fans. Starring alongside Yash are Nayanthara and Kiara Advani, showcasing their roles in a gripping tale of power and betrayal set in a violent criminal underworld. The public's positive reactions hint at strong box office prospects, while the buzz surrounding Yash's nude scene in the trailer adds an intriguing layer to the film's narrative.
item.dc:creator: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK

item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: 'Shouldn't be exclusive club': Pak minister seeks Nato-like Islamic military alliance
item.description: Pakistan's defense minister has put forth an innovative concept for an Islamic military coalition, reminiscent of NATO's structure. This initiative follows a newly established defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey, ensuring collective protection against external attacks. By leveraging Saudi wealth, Turkish defense technology, and Pakistan's military prowess, the agreement seeks to bolster regional defense capabilities and deter potential aggressors.
item.dc:creator: TOI NEWS DESK

item.title: ‘Organs unable to cope’: Jharkhand student leader’s health worsens after 15-day fast
item.description: Student leader Devendra Nath Mahto is facing a critical decline in health as he continues his hunger strike to advocate for essential reforms in Jharkhand's recruitment examination system. In response to the protests, the government has pledged to take the demands seriously and has set up a dedicated email ID for suggestions. Protesters are requesting the cancellation of certain exams and a CBI inquiry into the irregularities.
item.dc:creator: RK LAXMI

item.title: 'Should have gone to Ranchi': Rijiju takes dig at Rahul Gandhi over Prayagraj event
item.dc:creator: TOI NEWS DESK

item.title: Affordable housing stock shrinks, premium home inventory jumps 43%: Report
item.description: Unsold housing inventory in India rose four percent, with higher-priced homes seeing significant accumulation. Lower-priced properties below one crore rupees are selling faster, showing inventory declines. The overall time to sell existing stock increased to six quarters. Premium housing segments experienced both rising inventory and increased sales activity. Older housing stock is being absorbed, indicating buyer preference for near-completion properties.
item.dc:creator: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK

item.title: Bumrah to Sudharsan: Full list of players ruled out of Sri Lanka Tests
item.description: Sudharsan has been ruled out of the series after failing to recover from a big toe injury he suffered during the India A tour of Sri Lanka last month. He scored two centuries in the two 'A' Tests before being hit on the toe during the second match against Sri Lanka A. He has since been undergoing rehabilitation at the Centre of Excellence in Bengaluru.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.dc:creator: TOI NEWS DESK

item.title: Kavach: What makes Indian Railways indigenous world-class tech special
item.description: Indian Railways is prioritising Kavach deployment on high-density and highly used network routes, which carry nearly 96% of railway traffic. Now, the next-generation Kavach 5.0 is being developed for suburban rail operations with an aim to support higher train frequencies.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: Trump shoots from Senate shoulders to punish Russia, by making India, China pay
item.description: The US Senate approved a bill allowing President Trump to impose tariffs. This legislation targets nations buying Russian oil and gas, including India. India faces potential 100% tariffs for its energy purchases from Russia. The bill grants the president discretion and includes exemption provisions for allies. This move could impact global energy markets and US consumers significantly.
item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: PM Modi speaks to US VP Vance, discusses ways to deepen India-US strategic partnership
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with US Vice President JD Vance on Saturday. They discussed deepening the India-US Comprehensive Global Strategic Partnership across key areas. PM Modi also congratulated JD Vance and his wife Usha Vance. The Prime Minister conveyed his best wishes to the growing family. This conversation focused on strengthening bilateral relations between the two nations.
item.dc:creator: TOI NEWS DESK

item.title: 10 bullets in her pocket, minor girl visits UP jail to meet lover, cops outwit her
item.description: A minor girl was apprehended at Gonda jail with ten live cartridges. She attempted to meet her lover, an undertrial prisoner, using a fake identity. Jail personnel discovered the ammunition during a routine security check at the entrance. The girl claimed she took the cartridges fearing her father's reaction. Police are investigating the source of the ammunition and the fake identity document.
item.dc:creator: PATHIKRIT CHAKRABORTY

item.title: Eggs thrown at Kosovo PM in parliament; House suspended amid political crisis
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: No weekly offs, leave: Mysuru woman dies by suicide, names manager in death note
item.description: In a heartbreaking event in Mysuru, a woman ended her life after allegedly enduring harassment from her supervisor. She left behind a note that accused her manager of coercing her into making admissions of error and intimidating her about job security. A dedicated worker at a marketing firm for three years, her husband noted that she had been raising concerns about her manager’s behavior for the last month.
item.dc:creator: LAWRENCE MILTON

item.title: Nasa's Perseverance finds Mars can have warm ground but freezing air
item.description: Mars presents unique seasonal experiences with surface and air temperatures differing greatly. This phenomenon occurs because the planet's thin atmosphere cannot effectively distribute solar heat. Nasa's Perseverance rover has directly measured these sharp temperature contrasts near Jezero Crater. Such extreme variations pose significant challenges for rover and future human mission designs. Understanding these differences is crucial for engineering equipment to survive Martian conditions.
item.dc:creator: TOI SCIENCE DESK

item.dc:creator: CHIDANAND RAJGHATTA

item.title: Person-to-person transactions to remain free: Govt clarifies no charges for UPI users
item.description: In a press release, the Ministry of Finance has said that users will not be charged for making UPI payments, and all Person-to-Person (P2P) transactions will continue to remain free. It said that if a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) is introduced in the future, it will apply only to a limited category of merchant transactions above a specified threshold.
item.dc:creator: SMRITI JAIN

item.title: 'It was a complete lie': Babar refused Pathan interview? Here's what happened
item.description: Former India all-rounder Irfan Pathan recalled how fake news spread during the 2023 ODI World Cup after a Pakistani media outlet falsely claimed Babar Azam refused him an interview. Pathan said his face was photoshopped onto a Bangladeshi reporter’s image. He highlighted how such false stories gain millions of views, while recalling his successful international and IPL career.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK

item.title: Lionel Messi’s father Jorge Messi dies in Argentina after long illness
item.description: He was a key figure in Lionel Messi's career and remained involved from his son's early days as a footballer through his rise to the top of the sport. Jorge represented Messi in negotiations with clubs and commercial companies and helped build the business setup around the Argentine footballer.
item.dc:creator: TOI SPORTS DESK
